_comment: Engine settings (roadmap P5 step 8, docs/API_CONTRACTS.md). Read and checked at start-up by ArabiziCore's EngineConfig; the engine code holds no copy of these numbers. `model` is an id from config/models.json (file, SHA-256 and prompt come from there); it stays null, and use_model false, until the fine-tuned model is chosen (ADR 0005). Until then every request gets the rule fallback.
